headline: Bank of Ghana cuts policy rate to 11% from 14%
summary: The Bank of Ghana's Monetary Policy Committee reduced its benchmark interest rate by 300 basis points to 11%, citing improved economic conditions and declining market interest rates.
why: Central bank rate decisions are the primary tool for managing inflation and economic growth, directly influencing borrowing costs for businesses and consumers.

impacts.name: Bank of Ghana policy rate
impacts.why: The central bank lowered the benchmark rate by 300 basis points.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The rate cut is intended to ease monetary conditions as inflation and market interest rates decline.
